app: What I Bring to the Table
disclaimer: Nutrition values are estimates based on USDA FoodData Central. Not medical advice. Actual values vary by brand and prep. Allergy tags are ingredient heuristics, not lab tests. Cross-contact is possible. Never treat these as allergen-free claims.

recipes.name: Skillet Chicken & Rice
steps: Pat chicken dry, cut into pieces, season with salt and pepper.
Brown chicken in oil about 5 minutes; set aside.
Soften onion, then garlic.
Stir in rice, add broth, nestle chicken back, cover, and cook on low 18–20 minutes. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
Rest 5 minutes and fluff.
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Taco Night Ground Beef
steps: Brown beef with onion. Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
Stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin, and salt.
Warm tortillas and set out cheese, lettuce, tomato, and salsa.
Build tacos at the table.
safeTemp: Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Spaghetti with Meat Sauce
steps: Boil salted water for spaghetti.
Brown beef with onion in oil.
Add garlic and stir for about 1 minute.
Simmer tomatoes, paste, oregano, salt, and pepper 15–20 minutes.
Cook pasta, plate with sauce and Parmesan. Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Sausage & Veggies
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and bake until hot and cooked through.
Cut potatoes, peppers, broccoli, and sausage.
Toss with oil and spices.
Roast 25–30 minutes, stirring once. Cook sausage to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook sausage to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Cheesy Chicken Quesadillas
steps: Soften pepper and onion.
Fill tortillas with cheese, chicken, and veggies.
Fold and cook until golden and melty. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
Serve with salsa until everything is combined.
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Skillet Tuna Melts
steps: Mix tuna with mayo, celery, and mustard.
Butter bread outsides, build sandwiches with cheese, and skillet-toast until crisp. Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).

recipes.name: Black Bean Burritos
steps: Cook rice according to package directions until tender, then fluff with a fork.
Warm beans with onion, cumin, and salt.
Fill tortillas with rice, beans, cheese, and salsa.
Roll and serve until everything is combined.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Salmon
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Place salmon and broccoli on a sheet.
Spoon honey-soy-garlic-lemon over fish.
Bake 12–15 minutes until everything is combined. Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble eggs; set aside.
Stir-fry carrot, peas, and garlic.
Add cold rice, return eggs, splash soy sauce, and finish with green onion.

recipes.name: Weeknight Chickpea Curry
steps: Start the rice so it finishes with the rest of the dish.
Soften onion until everything is combined.
Add garlic, ginger, and spices.
Simmer tomatoes and coconut milk, then chickpeas, 10 minutes.
Serve over rice until everything is combined.

recipes.name: Turkey Chili
steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper.
Add garlic and spices, then tomatoes and beans.
Simmer 20–25 minutes. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Baked Potato Bar
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Oil and salt scrubbed potatoes.
Bake 45–55 minutes until everything is combined. Cook pork products such as ham or bacon until steaming hot throughout (USDA reheating guidance).
Split and top as you like.
safeTemp: Cook pork products such as ham or bacon until steaming hot throughout (USDA reheating guidance).

recipes.name: Garlic Shrimp Pasta
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, about 8–10 minutes, then drain. Cook shrimp until opaque and pink throughout (USDA seafood guidance).
Save pasta water until everything is combined.
Sear shrimp in oil and butter.
Add garlic and stir for about 1 minute.
Toss with pasta, lemon, and a splash of pasta water.
safeTemp: Cook shrimp until opaque and pink throughout (USDA seafood guidance).

recipes.name: Tofu Veggie Stir-Fry
steps: Cube tofu tossed with cornstarch.
Fry golden until everything is combined.
Stir-fry veggies with garlic and ginger.
Return tofu with soy and sesame oil over rice.

recipes.name: Homestyle Sloppy Joes
steps: Brown beef with onion.
Stir in ketchup, mustard, brown sugar, Worcestershire, and salt.
Simmer 10 minutes until everything is combined. Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
Spoon onto buns until everything is combined.
safeTemp: Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Comfort Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, then garlic.
Add broth and chicken.
Simmer 15 minutes until everything is combined.
Shred chicken, add noodles, cook until tender. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: BBQ Chicken Sheet Dinner
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and bake until hot and cooked through.
Brush chicken with BBQ sauce.
Roast with oiled corn and green beans 25–30 minutes. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Hearty Lentil Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery.
Add garlic and cumin.
Simmer lentils with tomatoes and broth 25–30 minutes.

recipes.name: Homemade Pizza Night
steps: Heat the oven to 475°F.
Stretch dough, oil lightly, add sauce and cheese.
Bake 12–15 minutes until browned.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Apples
steps: Sear seasoned chops; set aside.
Cook apple and onion in butter with brown sugar. Cook pork chops to an internal temperature of 145°F, then rest 3 minutes (USDA).
Return chops and finish on low.
safeTemp: Cook pork chops to an internal temperature of 145°F, then rest 3 minutes (USDA).

recipes.name: Beefy Skillet Stroganoff
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, about 8–10 minutes, then drain.
Brown beef with onion.
Add mushrooms and garlic.
Simmer with broth, then fold in sour cream off heat. Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
Toss everything together until evenly coated, then serve warm.
safeTemp: Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Slice chicken and veggies.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and spices.
Sear, then soften peppers and onion.
Splash lime and serve with tortillas. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Stovetop Mac & Cheese
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, about 8–10 minutes, then drain.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then milk until thick.
Stir in cheese and salt.
Fold pasta in until everything is combined.

recipes.name: Salmon Rice Bowls
steps: Cook rice according to package directions until tender, then fluff with a fork. Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).
Pan-sear salmon until everything is combined.
Build bowls with rice, flaked salmon, avocado, and cucumber.
Drizzle soy and sesame oil.
safeTemp: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).

recipes.name: Easy Veggie Lasagna
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Mix ricotta, egg, garlic, and half the Parmesan.
Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta, spinach, and mozzarella.
Bake covered 30 min, uncovered 15.

recipes.name: Ham & Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble eggs until everything is combined.
Stir-fry ham and peas, then cold rice. Cook pork products such as ham or bacon until steaming hot throughout (USDA reheating guidance).
Return eggs with soy sauce and green onion.
safeTemp: Cook pork products such as ham or bacon until steaming hot throughout (USDA reheating guidance).

recipes.name: Skillet Chicken Parmesan
steps: Dip chicken in egg then breadcrumbs.
Top with sauce and mozzarella.
Cover to melt until everything is combined. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
Serve with pasta until everything is combined.
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Bean & Cheese Enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Warm beans with onion and cumin.
Roll in tortillas with cheese.
Cover with salsa and more cheese.
Bake 20 minutes until everything is combined.

recipes.name: Sausage & Pepper Pasta
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, about 8–10 minutes, then drain.
Brown sausage with peppers and onion. Cook sausage to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
Add garlic and sauce.
Toss with pasta and Parmesan.
safeTemp: Cook sausage to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Lemon Chicken & Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and bake until hot and cooked through.
Toss chicken and potatoes with oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Roast 35–40 minutes. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Chili Mac Bowls
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, about 8–10 minutes, then drain.
Brown beef with onion and garlic.
Add chili powder, tomatoes, and beans.
Simmer 10 minutes until everything is combined. Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
Serve over pasta with cheese.
safeTemp: Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Pasta & Broccoli
steps: Cook pasta and broccoli together in the last 3 minutes.
Toss with butter, oil, garlic, Parmesan, salt, and pepper.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken Bowls
steps: Cook rice according to package directions until tender, then fluff with a fork.
Sear chicken; set aside.
Simmer soy, honey, garlic, ginger, and cornstarch until thick. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
Toss chicken and steamed broccoli.
Sprinkle sesame seeds.
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Cottage Pie Skillet
steps: Boil and mash potatoes with butter and milk.
Brown beef with onion and carrot.
Add peas and broth and stir for about 1 minute.
Top with mash and broil until golden. Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Sauté onion and garlic.
Add spices, tomatoes, beans, corn, broth, and chicken.
Simmer 15 minutes until everything is combined. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
Top with tortilla pieces.
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Loaded Dinner Omelette
steps: Sauté veggies in butter.
Pour in beaten seasoned eggs.
Add cheese and spinach.
Fold when set and serve hot.

recipes.name: Soft Beef Tacos
steps: Cook beef with onion and chili powder. Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
Warm tortillas and fill with beef, cheese, lettuce, tomato, and salsa.
safeTemp: Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Easy Mushroom Rice
steps: Sauté onion and mushrooms in oil and butter.
Add garlic and rice.
Add broth a cup at a time, stirring, until creamy.
Finish with Parmesan.

recipes.name: Honey Mustard Chicken
steps: Mix honey, mustard, and garlic.
Sear chicken, brush with sauce, and finish in a 375°F oven 15 minutes with roasted broccoli. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Southwest Bean & Rice Bowls
steps: Cook rice according to package directions until tender, then fluff with a fork.
Warm beans and corn with cumin and salt.
Build bowls with salsa, avocado, cheese, and lime.

recipes.name: Upgraded Pantry Ramen
steps: Cook noodles in boiling water until tender, about 3–4 minutes, then drain.
Soft-boil or scramble eggs.
Stir in garlic, soy, sesame oil, peas, and green onion.

recipes.name: Turkey Zucchini Boats
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Hollow zucchini halves.
Brown turkey with onion and garlic.
Mix with sauce until everything is combined.
Fill boats, top with cheese, bake 25 minutes. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Noodle Bowls
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, about 8–10 minutes, then drain.
Whisk peanut butter, soy, honey, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and lime with hot water.
Toss with noodles, carrot, and cucumber.

recipes.name: Breakfast-for-Dinner Scramble
steps: Crisp diced potatoes in butter.
Add pepper and onion.
Pour in eggs, scramble softly, fold in cheese, and season.

recipes.name: Stovetop Beefy Stew
steps: Brown beef with onion.
Add garlic, potatoes, carrot, celery, broth, and tomatoes.
Simmer 35–40 minutes until veggies are tender. Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Caprese Skillet Chicken
steps: Sear seasoned chicken in oil until cooked. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
Top with sliced tomato and mozzarella.
Cover to melt until everything is combined.
Finish with torn basil.
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Corn & Potato Chowder
steps: Soften onion in butter.
Stir in flour until everything is combined.
Add broth and diced potatoes.
Simmer until soft until everything is combined.
Add corn and milk and stir for about 1 minute.
Heat gently and season.

recipes.name: Turkey Meatball Skillet
steps: Mix turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic, salt, and Parmesan.
Brown meatballs in oil.
Add sauce and simmer 15 minutes. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
Serve over pasta until everything is combined.
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Spinach Egg Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Soften onion until everything is combined.
Wilt spinach until everything is combined.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and pepper.
Combine with cheese in a greased dish and bake 30–35 minutes.

recipes.name: Easy BBQ Pulled Chicken
steps: Shred chicken and warm with BBQ sauce.
Toss slaw with mayo.
Pile chicken on buns with slaw. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Sesame Chicken & Cucumber
steps: Cook rice according to package directions until tender, then fluff with a fork. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
Sear chicken until everything is combined.
Toss cucumber with soy, sesame oil, garlic, honey, and seeds.
Serve over rice until everything is combined.
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: White Bean & Greens Soup
steps: Sauté onion and carrot.
Add garlic and stir for about 1 minute.
Add beans and broth.
Simmer 15 minutes until everything is combined.
Stir in spinach to wilt.

recipes.name: Cheeseburger Pasta Skillet
steps: Brown beef with onion.
Add uncooked pasta, broth, tomato sauce, ketchup, and mustard.
Cover and simmer until pasta is tender. Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
Stir in cheese until everything is combined.
safeTemp: Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Black Bean Skillet
steps: Cube sweet potato and cook in oil until tender.
Add onion and pepper, then beans and spices.
Finish with salsa and lime.

recipes.name: Warm Tuna Pasta
steps: Cook pasta with peas in the last 2 minutes. Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).
Toss with drained tuna, mayo, lemon, celery, salt, and pepper while warm.
safeTemp: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).

recipes.name: Sausage & White Beans
steps: Brown sliced sausage with onion.
Add garlic, tomatoes, and beans.
Simmer 10 minutes until everything is combined. Cook sausage to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
Wilt spinach at the end.
safeTemp: Cook sausage to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Chicken Veggie Stir-Fry
steps: Cook rice according to package directions until tender, then fluff with a fork.
Stir-fry chicken; set aside.
Cook veggies, then return chicken with soy, garlic, ginger, honey, and cornstarch slurry. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Tomato Mozzarella Pasta
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, about 8–10 minutes, then drain.
Warm oil with garlic.
Add chopped tomatoes until juicy.
Toss pasta with sauce, torn mozzarella, and basil.

recipes.name: Beef & Cabbage Skillet
steps: Brown beef with onion.
Add shredded cabbage and carrot.
Cook until wilted until everything is combined. Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
Stir in garlic and soy sauce.
safeTemp: Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Creamy Yogurt Chicken
steps: Mix yogurt, garlic, lemon, cumin, paprika, and salt.
Coat the chicken evenly with the yogurt mixture.
Bake at 400°F about 30 minutes. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
Serve with rice until everything is combined.
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Savory Pancake Supper
steps: Whisk flour, milk, eggs, and salt.
Cook pancakes in butter.
Fill with wilted spinach and cheese, fold, and serve.

recipes.name: Leftover Chicken Wraps
steps: Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet until soft and pliable, about 30 seconds per side. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
Fill with chicken, lettuce, cheese, salsa, and avocado if you have it.
Roll and serve until everything is combined.
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Avocado Cucumber Sandwich
steps: Mash avocado with lemon, salt, and pepper.
Spread mayo on bread, layer mashed avocado and thin cucumber slices, and close the sandwiches.
Slice in half and serve right away.

recipes.name: Veggie Club Sandwich
steps: Toast bread lightly if you like.
Spread mayo on the slices, then stack lettuce, tomato, cucumber, avocado, and cheddar into two triple-decker clubs.
Secure with toothpicks, cut into halves, and serve.

recipes.name: Turkey Avocado Wrap
steps: Warm tortillas until soft.
Spread mayo, layer ham, sliced avocado, lettuce, and tomato.
Roll tightly, tuck the ends, and slice on a bias.
Heat ham until steaming hot throughout (165°F if reheating leftovers, USDA).
safeTemp: Heat ham until steaming hot throughout (165°F if reheating leftovers, USDA).

recipes.name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
steps: Drain tuna and flake into a bowl.
Mix with mayo, minced celery, and mustard.
Pile onto bread with lettuce and close the sandwiches.
Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).

recipes.name: Egg Salad Sandwich
steps: Hard-boil eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel, and chop.
Fold eggs with mayo, mustard, minced celery, salt, and pepper.
Spread on bread with lettuce and serve.
Cook eggs until yolks and whites are firm if serving to young children, older adults, or anyone with a weaker immune system (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook eggs until yolks and whites are firm if serving to young children, older adults, or anyone with a weaker immune system (USDA).

recipes.name: BLT Sandwich
steps: Cook bacon in a skillet until crisp; drain on paper towels.
Toast bread and spread with mayo.
Layer lettuce, tomato, and bacon; close and serve hot.
safeTemp: Cook bacon until crisp and the fat is rendered; handle hot pans carefully.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese
steps: Butter the outsides of the bread.
Sandwich cheddar between slices and cook in a skillet over medium heat until golden and the cheese melts, about 3 minutes per side.
Slice and serve warm.

recipes.name: Cucumber Tomato Salad
steps: Slice cucumber and tomato into bite-size pieces.
Toss with thin onion, olive oil, lemon, salt, and pepper.
Chill 5 minutes or serve right away.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Mash avocado with lemon, salt, and pepper.
Spread thickly on toast, drizzle a little olive oil, and serve.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Sandwich
steps: Spread peanut butter on bread.
Add sliced banana, close the sandwiches, and cut in half.
Serve right away.

recipes.name: Hummus Veggie Wrap
steps: Warm tortillas until pliable.
Spread hummus, then layer cucumber, lettuce, tomato, and shredded carrot.
Roll tightly and slice in half.

recipes.name: Cream Cheese Cucumber Sandwich
steps: Stir lemon and pepper into cream cheese.
Spread on bread, top with thin cucumber slices, and close.
Trim crusts if you like and cut into triangles.

recipes.name: Ham and Cheese Sandwich
steps: Spread mayo and mustard on bread.
Layer ham, cheddar, and lettuce.
Close, slice, and pack or serve.
Heat ham until steaming hot throughout (165°F if reheating leftovers, USDA).
safeTemp: Heat ham until steaming hot throughout (165°F if reheating leftovers, USDA).

recipes.name: Chicken Salad Sandwich
steps: Shred chicken and mix with mayo, minced celery, lemon, salt, and pepper.
Scoop onto bread with lettuce.
Close the sandwiches and serve.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Greek Cucumber Chickpea Bowl
steps: Chop cucumber, tomato, and lettuce.
Toss with rinsed chickpeas, olive oil, lemon, and a pinch of salt.
Stir minced garlic into yogurt for a quick sauce and spoon over the bowls.

recipes.name: Avocado Egg Toast
steps: Toast bread and mash avocado with salt and pepper; spread on toast.
Fry or scramble eggs in butter until set.
Top the avocado toast with eggs and serve.
Cook eggs until yolks and whites are firm if serving to young children, older adults, or anyone with a weaker immune system (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook eggs until yolks and whites are firm if serving to young children, older adults, or anyone with a weaker immune system (USDA).

recipes.name: Turkey Club Wrap
steps: Cook bacon until crisp; drain.
Warm tortillas, spread mayo, and layer ham, bacon, lettuce, and tomato.
Roll up tightly and slice.
Cook bacon until crisp and the fat is rendered; handle hot pans carefully.
Heat ham until steaming hot throughout (165°F if reheating leftovers, USDA).
safeTemp: Cook bacon until crisp and the fat is rendered; handle hot pans carefully.
Heat ham until steaming hot throughout (165°F if reheating leftovers, USDA).

recipes.name: Tuna Avocado Bowl
steps: Cook rice until tender; fluff and divide into bowls.
Flake tuna with mayo and a splash of soy sauce.
Top rice with tuna, diced avocado, cucumber, and green onion.
Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).

recipes.name: Caprese Sandwich
steps: Layer mozzarella, tomato, and basil on bread.
Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle salt, and close.
Press lightly and slice.

recipes.name: Hummus Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Spread hummus, top with sliced avocado and cucumber, and finish with lemon.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Cheesy Quesadillas
steps: Scatter cheddar (and minced jalapeño if using) on tortillas and fold.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet until cheese melts and tortillas are golden.
Slice into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Banana Oat Yogurt Bowl
steps: Divide yogurt into bowls.
Top with oats, sliced banana, and a drizzle of honey.
Add a spoon of peanut butter if you like and serve.

recipes.name: Creamy Tomato Soup
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in butter until soft.
Add chopped tomato (and a splash of broth if using); simmer 12 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Stir in cream, season, and serve with toasted bread.

recipes.name: Quinoa Veggie Bowl
steps: Cook quinoa in water until fluffy, about 15 minutes; cool slightly.
Toss with cucumber, tomato, chickpeas, lemon, and olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper and serve warm or cold.

recipes.name: Bean Avocado Tostadas
steps: Crisp tortillas in a lightly oiled skillet.
Warm and mash the beans with a pinch of salt.
Spread beans on tortillas, top with avocado, lettuce, cheddar, and salsa.

recipes.name: Mixed Veggie Fried Rice
steps: Scramble eggs in oil; set aside.
Stir-fry garlic and frozen mixed vegetables until hot.
Add rice, soy sauce, eggs, and green onion; toss until everything is hot and combined.
Cook eggs until yolks and whites are firm if serving to young children, older adults, or anyone with a weaker immune system (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook eggs until yolks and whites are firm if serving to young children, older adults, or anyone with a weaker immune system (USDA).

recipes.name: Classic Potato Salad
steps: Boil potatoes until tender; cool and cube.
Hard-boil eggs, peel, and chop.
Fold potatoes and eggs with mayo, mustard, celery, onion, salt, and pepper; chill before serving.
Cook eggs until yolks and whites are firm if serving to young children, older adults, or anyone with a weaker immune system (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook eggs until yolks and whites are firm if serving to young children, older adults, or anyone with a weaker immune system (USDA).

recipes.name: Cucumber Hummus Plate
steps: Cut cucumber and carrot into sticks.
Spoon hummus into a bowl in the center of a plate.
Arrange veggies (and toast fingers if using) around the hummus and serve.

recipes.name: Open-Face Avocado Mayo Melt
steps: Toast bread under a broiler for 1 minute.
Spread mayo, add avocado and tomato, top with cheddar.
Broil until cheese melts, about 2 minutes; serve open-faced.

recipes.name: Egg Mayo Rice Bowl
steps: Cook rice until tender.
Hard-boil eggs, chop, and fold with mayo and a splash of soy sauce.
Serve egg mayo over rice with cucumber and green onion.
Cook eggs until yolks and whites are firm if serving to young children, older adults, or anyone with a weaker immune system (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook eggs until yolks and whites are firm if serving to young children, older adults, or anyone with a weaker immune system (USDA).

recipes.name: Weeknight Spaghetti
steps: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic until no pink remains. Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).
Stir in pasta sauce and simmer 8 minutes.
Cook pasta until al dente; drain and toss with the sauce. Serve with Parmesan.
safeTemp: Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 160°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Chicken Soy Veggie Rice
steps: Cook rice until tender.
Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and stir-fry in oil with garlic until cooked through. Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
Add frozen mixed vegetables and soy sauce; toss with the rice and heat through.
safeTemp: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Bean & Cheddar Tortilla Skillet
steps: Cook rice; warm beans with a pinch of salt (and cumin if using).
Warm tortillas; fill with rice, beans, cheddar, and tomatoes or salsa if you have them.
Roll or fold and serve.

recipes.name: Lemon Salmon Broccoli Rice
steps: Cook rice until tender.
Roast or pan-sear salmon and broccoli with olive oil, salt, pepper, and lemon until the fish flakes. Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).
Serve salmon and broccoli over rice with extra lemon.
safeTemp: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).

recipes.name: Creamy Potato Veggie Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, and celery in butter until soft.
Add cubed potatoes and broth; simmer until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes.
Mash a few potatoes in the pot for body, stir in milk, season, and serve hot.

recipes.name: Chicken Mayo Wrap
steps: Warm tortillas until soft.
Spread mayo, add shredded chicken, lettuce, and tomato if you have it.
Roll tightly and slice in half.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).
safeTemp: Heat leftover poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (USDA).

recipes.name: Simple Scrambled Eggs
steps: Beat eggs with salt and pepper.

Melt butter in a skillet and scramble the eggs over medium-low heat until just set. Cook eggs until yolks and whites are firm if serving to young children, older adults, or anyone with a weaker immune system (USDA).
Add cheddar if using; serve with toast if you have bread.

recipes.name: Tuna Mayo Sandwich
steps: Drain tuna and mix with mayo and minced celery (and mustard if using).
Spread on bread with lettuce if you have it.
Close the sandwiches and serve.
Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).
safeTemp: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F, or until flesh flakes easily (USDA).

recipes.name: Chopped Chickpea Salad
steps: Chop lettuce, cucumber, and tomato; rinse chickpeas.
Toss with olive oil and a pinch of salt (lemon if using).
Top with avocado if you have it and serve.

allergenPolicy: Allergens are derived from ingredient ids at build time, including hidden sources (soy-sauce→soy+wheat, mayo→egg, worcestershire→fish, coconut-milk→tree-nut per FDA labeling). Not lab tests; cross-contact possible. Not medical advice.
